name: Ontario Innovation Tax Credit (OITC)
eligibilitySummary: Ontario tax credit for companies conducting R&D in Ontario. 8-12% refundable credit on eligible R&D expenditures. Must be Ontario-based corporation.

funding.description: 8% non-refundable or 12% refundable credit on eligible Ontario R&D expenditures

application.applicationRequirements: File with Ontario corporate tax return. Must have permanent establishment in Ontario and qualify for federal SR&ED.
